note: Cognitive complexity and class size recorded from the commit named in `revision`: per member, per class and per type size. Members are keyed by qualified signature (not file:line, so moving a method between the partials of its class is not a new offender, and a lambda by its nearest named owner plus its ordinal, so inserting lines above it is not one either); `file` and `line` are recorded for the reader. A ts member that reads at Biome's ceiling carries `saturated: true`, because 255 is that producer's floor and not a count - it cannot be grown past and it cannot be verified to have held still. An entry may carry a `reason` naming the commit that bought its growth, and `--update` keeps it. Re-record with `node tools/check-cognitive-complexity.mjs --update` in its own commit. The ts numbers come from Biome's complexity/noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity and the cs numbers from this gate's own S3776 implementation over tree-sitter-c-sharp; the two are never compared or summed, so each carries its own `producer`.
